questions.question: Jesus told Nicodemus that a man must be born again. Where did Nicodemus ask if an old man would have to go back to?
Jesus said that just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, who must also be lifted up?
When Jesus talked with Nicodemus, why did He say God sent His Son into the world?

answers.text: To save the world through Him
To give the world a new law
To rebuild the temple in Jerusalem

questions.question: Jesus told Nicodemus the Light has come into the world. How did people respond to the Light?

answers.text: They gave thanks for the Light
They waited for a greater sign
